policy.principle: A repeatable agent process in this Organization is written down as a skill.
policy.claude_compatibility: .claude/skills is a byte-for-byte mirror of the skill directories in .agents/skills; root CI checks the mirror.

skills.description: Use before a non-trivial change to code, documentation or a workflow in this Organization. It takes the agent from owning the outcome through a plan and a worktree to a sustainable, verified change.

Use before producing anything visual or formatted (web page, presentation, document, offer, table, email template or UI). It finds the Organization source of truth first and then points the agent to the design system.

Use when the user plans a new feature, an experiment, a larger change in how the Organization works or cross-scope work. It anchors the plan in Mission Control first and only then derives implementation steps.

Use when work inside a workspace module changes its source-of-truth boundaries, data model, contracts, sync workflow or runtime behaviour. It keeps the module README, ARCHITECTURE, AGENTS and plans in step.
